text:
Tess L: Quick shout 1: impromptu LAN on the mezzanine tonight? We have 3 consoles, 2 PCs, and a tiny projector. Thinking chill co-op + a goofy 4-player Rocket League mini-tourney.

Ravi P: I'm down. I can bring an extra ethernet cable and a small unmanaged 5-port switch. No promises on skill in Rocket League though. :sweat_smile:

Anya V: I can bring my PC + Steam Deck for handheld corner. Also have an HDMI splitter if we want to mirror a match on the projector.

Cole M: I'll bring a capture card (USB3) and a mic for silly commentary. Also will bring a spare PS4 controller that still works.

Tess L: Awesome. Two quick things: 1) the mezzanine outlet on the left is finicky, we need a long extension cord; 2) please label your controllers so they don't get swapped in the chaos.

Maya (events): partybot:poll "Start" "6:30pm" "7:30pm"

partybot: Poll created: "Start" 1 votes: 6:30pm (3), 7:30pm (1).

Ravi P: FYI for the Netplay folks: set static IPs at the host if you're bridging to the office AP. Quick command on Linux hosts if you need it: `sudo nmcli con mod <name> ipv4.method manual ipv4.addresses 10.10.10.50/24 ipv4.gateway 10.10.10.1`

Anya V: Also, if anyone wants to join remotely via Steam Remote Play, test NAT ahead of time. Parsec tends to be more reliable on our network.

Cole M: I'll stream a few matches to #random and toss a 30s highlight into the thread afterwards. If you don't want to be on camera, wave a hand at me before your match.

Tess L: Who's bringing snacks? I can pick up a 2-topping pizza and some chips. Any allergies/sensitivities?

Maya (events): partybot:poll "Snacks" "Pizza" "Pretzels" "Fruit"

partybot: Poll created: "Snacks"  Pizza (4), Pretzels (1), Fruit (0).

Ravi P: I can bring a sugar-free option. Also a small staple gun + tape for cable tidying. Safety first.

Anya V: One logistics note: mezzanine is low on seating. Bring foldable chairs if you can. Also bring jackets 1 gets breezy.

Tess L: Final: meetup 6:30pm. @Cole M thanks for capture + stream. @Ravi P thanks for switch. Label controllers and bring ID for rooftop access if you stick around after. :party_popper:

Cole M: I'll drop the stream link ~10 minutes before start and upload a short highlight clip after.

Maya (events): Event posted with access instructions. See you all tonight.

Ravi P: See you! Anyone need a ride with gear? I'm heading from downtown.
